description: A plump loaf-shaped cat lying down: a rounded rectangular body with two small pointed ears on top, dot eyes and a tiny nose-mouth mark at the left, and a short tail curling back across its right side.
A front-facing boy's head with a rounded jaw, a hair mass with a wavy fringe sweeping across the forehead, small side ears, dot eyes under short brows, and a gentle smile.

concept: Horned Goat Head with Floating Eye
description: A front-facing goat head with long drooping horns curling down on both sides, a narrow tapering muzzle with two slanted eye marks, and a separate almond eye with a round pupil floating above its brow.
A front-facing goat head, symmetric about its vertical axis, with two long horns sweeping outward and down, a long face tapering to a rounded muzzle, two slanted eyes and an almond mark on the brow.
A front-facing boy's head with a shaggy hair outline gathered to the lower left, a jagged scar mark on the forehead, and two short slanted closed-eye dashes.
A small upright dinosaur standing and facing left, with a large rounded snout, a single dot eye, a short clawed arm held in front of its chest, bent legs and a thick tail sweeping out to the right.
A handheld gadget with a rounded octagonal body, small rectangular nubs on its left and right sides, and a large central double-ring screen with a circular window.

A figure seen from the front: a tall domed bald head, a round goggle or nose ring at centre, a wide handlebar moustache spreading to both sides, and a rounded body with two arms hanging down; the reference is hard to read.
A head-and-shoulders bust: an oval head crossed by a vertical centre line and a curved horizontal eye line as drawing guidelines, above two sloping shoulder curves.

A circular dragon emblem: a serpentine body wrapping around the rim of a circle, a hooked head curling inward at the top, and pointed wing and tail shapes filling the lower half; the reference is hard to read.
A front-facing head topped by large spiky hair with pointed tufts radiating up and to both sides, above a small round face with dot eyes and a smile.
An arched stone doorway: a tall round-topped arch with a parallel inner arch, a keyhole at the centre of the door, and a wide rectangular brick plinth with arched openings along the bottom.
A dwarf seen from the front: a round Viking helmet with a vertical centre ridge, a brim band and two curved horns rising outward, above a long rounded beard hanging to a U-shaped bottom.
